tool_input.command: ls -la data/ && echo "---METRICS---" && cat data/metrics.json && echo "---MODEL (head)---" && head -c 500 data/model.json

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
print('PROJECT:', proj.name)
mr = proj.get_model_registry()
print('MR type:', type(mr))
print('--- mr dir ---')
print([m for m in dir(mr) if not m.startswith('_')])
" 2>&1 | tail -40

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
mr = proj.get_model_registry()
print('--- python ---')
print([m for m in dir(mr.python) if not m.startswith('_')])
import inspect
print('--- create_model sig ---')
print(inspect.signature(mr.python.create_model))
print('--- create_model doc ---')
print(inspect.getdoc(mr.python.create_model))
" 2>&1 | tail -60

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import hopsworks, inspect
proj = hopsworks.login()
mr = proj.get_model_registry()
m = mr.python.Model
print(inspect.signature(m.save))
" 2>&1 | tail -10

cd "$(pwd)" && mkdir -p submission .tmp/artifact && cp data/model.json .tmp/artifact/model.json && python -c "
import hopsworks, json, os

with open('data/metrics.json') as f:
    metrics = json.load(f)

proj = hopsworks.login()
mr = proj.get_model_registry()

model = mr.python.create_model(
    name='churnmodelec96f5',
    version=1,
    metrics=metrics,
)
model.save('.tmp/artifact')
print('SAVED model name=', model.name, 'version=', model.version)
print('attached metrics=', model.training_metrics)

answers = {'model_name': 'churnmodelec96f5', 'version': 1, 'metrics': metrics}
with open('submission/answers.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(answers, f, indent=2)
print('WROTE submission/answers.json')
" 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Register model with metrics and artifact, write answers
